company_info.company_description: "GI Energy supply and install high quality solar equipment for customers who want solar that is built to last.We treat our customers like family and our whole team is dedicated to being at your disposal whenever you need us, for the life of your solar system. We have been looking after people this way and helping Aussies save money with high quality solar systems since 2011.Gold Supplier with SolarQuotes.Gold Installer with Enphase.Diamond Dealer with Sumec Phono.Tesla Powerwall Certified.One of the first ever CEC Approved Solar Retailers in Australia.The team that is here to help you is made up of electrical engineers, Clean Energy Council (CEC) Accredited Designers (Editors note: now SAA accreditation), CEC (SAA) installers, experienced project managers and consultants who specialise in solar PV and energy reduction strategies.Our mission is to build long-term relationships with our customers by providing market leading energy reduction strategies through innovation and advanced technology."

reviews.review_description: Really happy with the quote process. The installers showed up when they said they would and got the job done. No problems. Great customer service

Tom from GI Energy was the first person to respond to our request for quotation. He took the time to understand our requirements and needs and was always available with prompt replies to our many questions.Once we had decided the process was smooth with GI Energy arranging all approvals and rebates.The installation team of Sean, Sam and Samuel were fantastic, very neat and respectful of our property.Overall a very professional organisation who we have no hesitation in recommending.

I submitted a request for a quote for adding additional solar and a battery. The same day I had a response and phone call from James who was very helpful and asked all the right questions. I received a quote within a day and after a few more questions from me I accepted the quote soon after. Everything after that went smoothly, Vanessa organised grid approval within a day, then the install team came out and checked the site prior to work to ensure they captured everything. Install date was booked in and everything happened on time and went smoothly on the day. From start to finish the whole thing seemed effortless as everyone was well trained in their respective areas. I would recommend chatting to the team if you are considering a new or upgraded system.

GI Energy recently completed our solar and battery installation, and their customer service was truly exceptional. It took me nearly six months to make up my mind, and they were patient and never made me feel as if anything was an issue.The entire team was professional, knowledgeable, and always went above and beyond to answer our questions and keep us informed every step of the way. Installation was seamless, neat, and efficient, and they took the time to make sure we fully understood how the system works and I can ring them anytime. It's rare to find such dedicated support—highly recommend GI Energy for anyone considering solar, but also want the extra customer service. They help me with choosing a retailer that is suited to my use and helped me config the battery to suit my plan. Thanks again for the fantastic experience!
From start to finish GI was very helpful answering my questions with answers I understood and supplied exactly what I was aiming for.
Installation was excellent. Service can't be faulted. Happy with price
Great service, very knowledgeable and quality work, well done from sales to installation.
Extremely fast quoting and advising process. Never tried to upsell me or push me towards something I didn't need. Very patient through the whole process and got my install done extremely fast.

James at GI energy was highly efficient and providing me a quick and accurate quote. As a person that doesn’t know much about solar, James was able to educate me and provide a quote for a system that was for my needs and future needs.From quote acceptance the team was very helpful, and their communication was perfect to line up the install.The team on the day were near and tidy.I am very happy with the whole experience.

I was very happy with the quoting process from GI Energy and also with their follow up and answers to my many questions. The installers did a great job and were polite and friendly, and after installation GI Energy registered my product and helped me create my online account. Everyone I dealt with was helpful and knowledgeable.

Sales and quoting team (James G) was incredibly patient with my many, many  questions and suggestions for how we could achieve what I wanted.I had east and west roof that I really wanted to have covered with as many panels as I could get up there, even though my north facing could fit 8kw on its own. We ended up with over 14kw, some on tilts on a flat section of roof, with a split matching N+E string and a N+W string. Their installation team in Brisbane were very prompt and tidy. Communication was always great.We went aiko +fronius.Highly recommend

The quoting process was mostly  straightforward. We went with GI because they seemed very knowledgeable and able to adapt to our particular needs. Uniformity of components was also a selling point.The installation was brilliant. They were efficient, tidy and helpful. The guy in charge, Luke, really believed in the system and was very helpful in showing how it operated. Essentially, as soon as the system was installed, it was operational.

Thomas at Gi Energy was great during the sales process and spent a decent amount of time to go through the planned system so that I understood the different nuances of each component and how it would affect the performance and cost.The installation team were punctual, polite and professional and got the job done in about 4 hours which also included make some additional adjustments to the switchboard so that we had ample space for the smart meter upgrade which is a necessity if you don't already have one.Whilst we didn't go for the biggest system out there due to a combination of our usage, roof space and cost, the performance so far (at least through the Sungrow app) is certainly meeting our needs. I look forward to seeing what our next monthly electricity bill looks like after we have had a full month of solar.

James, Ivan and the team at GI Energy have been amazing to deal with at every interation.James listened to my needs and worked with me to create the perfect system for my needs. An Aiko 13.2kw system, with a15kw Sungrow inverter and a 12.8kw solar battery. He even arranged for the installer, Stuart, to install an Ocular electric car charger that I was given when I bought my Kia EV6.James also went above and beyond to assist me with securing finance through Bright.Stuart and his installation team arranged to come out multiple times prior to installation day to get the prep work done. He always gave advance notice and arrived on time. Installation was completed on time and the system has been working brilliantly since turned on.One incident post installation was due to a software upgrade. Ivan was able to work with me to resolve it quickly.James and Ivan have always been quick to respond whenever I needed to change the schedule of the battery charging or discharging. They have proven to be a true energy partner.If you are looking at anything to do with Solar or Battery, be sure to include GI Energy in your research. I spoke with over 10 retailers and am extremly happy I chose them.

Sales were honest and didn't try to upsell.Very punctual and the installation was smooth and the workmanship was very neat and tidy.They arranged the connection once the install was completed and the Isolar management app is very user friendly.

Fantastic sales team (James) who were really on the front foot. $5k cheaper than a well known local company and the gear quoted was better quality.Local installer/contractor was good and worked in well with us and GI Energy.Truly great customer service with getting set up, helping me understand the system and then advising for electric car charging using solar tracking (it only charges off excess solar!). Smart hot water relay works perfectly.I highly recommend James and the team at GI Energy. 10/10.

I recently had a 11.44kw solar system installed, and I couldn’t be more thrilled with the results! From start to finish, the experience has been nothing short of exceptional. The installation team (Stuart and his team) was incredibly professional, arriving on time and ensuring that every detail was handled with the utmost care.The quality of the panels and the technology used is impressive, and the efficiency of the system has already made a noticeable difference in my energy bills. Not only am I thrilled about the environmental benefits, but it's also fantastic to see my solar system generating power via the Fronius monitoring app.The team at GI Energy were great to deal with, the entire process was seamless, and the customer service has been top-notch, answering all my questions and providing clear, helpful guidance.I highly recommend GI Energy. They’ve exceeded all my expectations, and I’m excited to be part of the clean energy revolution!
From sales through to installation GI Energy were great. Wild recommend to anyone.

We are extremely satisfied with the customer experience provided by GI Energy. From the beginning to the end, GI Energy has delivered a professional service and acted in our best interest. James took the time to visit our house to discuss solution options. The options presented were clear and well suited to our needs, and the products recommended by GI Energy were of high quality and good value. Although the other quotes and services we received were also good, GI Energy stood out. Communication throughout the sales process, leading up to installation and post-installation, was flawless. Despite having to contend with challenging weather conditions, the installation looks great and was completed within the original timeframe by Stu and Dan. Overall, we are satisfied with our decision, the system is performing great, and GI Energy has displayed true professionalism!

All staff that i interacted with were friendly and helpful. The installers consulted me on the position of the inverter. They also recommended a change of the positioning of the solar panels so that birds do not poo on the new panels. I felt well informed by staff on the next steps for connecting to the grid.

Quote was accurate - they even covered the cost of an extra required inverter not originally included in the quote. System was installed within a reasonable time and is working perfectly. I have been informed that the grid connection has been organised. Looking forward to much smaller electricity bills. I am already generating more electricity than I am using.

I was able to trust the advice from James Greenwood from GI Energy as it never waivered from the principles of providing quality advice in a very confusing and conflicting marketplace. Each time I had concerns about a system config or competitive systems they answered it fully and openly. In the end I was able to trust their advice and was happy to pay the premium on the system they designed to get the peace of mind that the system will work for years and any future add-ons or service will be handled professionally

I was impressed how Michael and his team went about the Phono solar panels and inverter installation. There was no mucking around they just got straight onto it from the moment they arrived.The only thing that took the shine off a little was the fiddling around with the Fronious Inverter app trying to connect it to the inverter, though I can’t blame Michael for that.In the end, all good.

Our whole journey with GI Energy was fantastic. The sales team helped me fully understand the total ins and outs of it all which made me really comfortable making a decision.They were not the cheapest quote we got but after doing some research on their company, products and the other companies who quoted us - we understood why they were a little more expensive too.We are 1000% happy with our decision and would recommend the team at GI Energy to anyone.

Thomas was so helpful and prompt, answering all my questions, giving me a full breakdown of the costs and explaining why they were recommending certain systems for me and my needs. Didn’t give me the hard sell and listened to what I needed whilst giving great advice.The installers were polite and friendly, tidied up after themselves and made sure I understood the inverter and the functions of the app before they left.Really top notch service from start to finish. I’ve already recommended them to family and friends.

I was very impressed by GI Energy and Aus Electrical Solutions. Communication was positive and friendly and the quality of the installation was excellent. I would be very happy to use either company again in the future.

GI Energy was the first of the three Solar Quotes responses that we received. We I also approached three other companies directly for comparison purposes.The very first conversation with Matt from GI Energy was so helpful. He explained all our options and answered every question patiently. At no time did we feel rushed. He certainly set the bar high for others and most failed, with the exception of the other two Solar Quotes referrals, both of whom were worthy of consideration.Ultimately we chose GI Energy due to its approach to customer service, its quality products and installation, great reviews and its commitment to sustainability that goes beyond many of its competitors.Was GI Energy the cheapest? It was between the two other Solar Quotes referrals (slightly  different inverter/panel mix) but more than the cheaper rivals. However, when it came to commitments around warranties, service, installation, etc, GI Energy was way ahead of its cheaper competitors. As this installation will probably be our last purchase of solar panels for our roof, we wanted to ensure that we made no mistakes.We were delighted with the installation process which was expertly handled by Stu and Dan. It wasn't an easy install due to the conditions, but they just got on with it and despite the odds, managed to finish the job in one day. They also did some meter box work (RCBOs) for us within the price charged.GI Energy has been so easy to communicate with throughout the process and we are confident that we made the best choice for our replacement solar panels and inverter.

Salesman was good friendly, good knowledge of systems etc.Great people who installed their system, very polite, installation was clean, listened to what I wanted and where I want things to go.Great customer service, did absolutely everything that was needed.

Quoting process was excellent.Installation went well with a few hiccupsI am awaiting final app.to complete installation process.Also awaiting missing battery wall anchor brackets (not included in the box supplied)Also awaiting safety bollard also not supplied but required by regulation.The system works extremely well, was installed on a Tuesday and had the first power blackout on Friday. This was one of the reasons I wanted a battery installed. Ergon supply issues.

The sales process was commendable; however, my primary interest lay in the Fronius GEN24 inverter for its backup battery feature and hybrid system capabilities. Regrettably, the sales representative clarified that the backup battery would not be perpetually available and could not be utilised during a power outage. Given my lack of immediate plans to acquire batteries, I decided to select a slightly less advanced model.The installation team, on the other hand, was exceptional and maintained clear communication throughout the entire installation process. They enlightened me about if I had gone with the Gen24 I could have utilised the GEN24 Inverter's backup feature on a nightly basis. Additionally, they clarified that this system would enable continuous power production to my residence during the day, even amidst a power outage.
Easy to deal with, everything went smoothly. Looking forward to the savings.

From Start (Quoting Process) to Finish (System Up/Running and Monitoring) I cannot fault the professionalism of GI Energy and their Staff.Their Sales/Quoting process was exceptionally informative with lots of questions and answers given from both sides.Their were no hitches or glitches with our Installation.  Everything was taken care of professionally.I was assured that I would have nothing to worry about and that everything would be taken care of.  That statement was 100 per cent True. They took care of absolutely everything. They contacted my Energy provider to inform them of what was happening. They even helped me to download a Solar Monitoring App and then showed me how to interpret the information.Have we been left High and Dry now that the job is complete and we are Generating our own power.  No way!  We have been sent a link to the GI Energy Product Support Centre where you can access information on set-up support, product features, monitoring guides, maximising your savings, fault codes and resolutions. We have even had a visit from the fellow that gave us our original Quote to ensure that we are 100 per cent happy.  His parting words were "We are only a phone call away should you need our help in any way".  To date I have absolutely not been given any reason to doubt those words.

Research: so much to understand.Sales: many iterations while I was determining what I needed/wanted.Installation: completed in a single day instead of 2 and very friendly, patient and informative.After Install: system is easy to manage. However, even with maximum panels, battery, you still require grid and to pay the daily system charge for connection to it. Government limitations to how much you can feed in, the increase in Retail tariffs when you go solar and small payout for FIT, I still wonder if it is worth such an outlay… time will tell.

Got 2 quotes . Offered similar but different at the same time. Spoke to both and both friendly. Went with GI energy in the end as they offered the system which suited our needs and James whom I dealt was a wealth of knowledge and great response to all the questions.Installation was early due to cancellation. The team from Chispa were on time and finished without any problems

The sales process from G.I Energy was very good as Tom worked with me to find the best solution for me and made it easy for me to ask questions. He made every effort to understand my needs.He was always on my side and wanted me to be happy.He never told me what I needed but had the right combination of system elements available that would work best for me and worked with me to find the best solution.The installation went well, the team used quality fittings and worked hard to get a nice neat job done.The customer service has been very good.They encourage me to call with any questions that I have which I have done and always have time to help me.Being in a regional area the price was more than in the capital city but this is the way it is.As it turns out we are making good power and the payoff time looks to be 4 or 5 years.G.I Energy got it right.P.S There are so many websites available for research. Solar Quotes was excellent as were others.I encourage anyone to do a bit of research along the way. It helped me understand things and gave me a base for all of my questions to ask.

The sales quoting process was very good, GI Energy were clear and transparent. They discussed all the options available and were able to explain the difference between the mid-range cost system I was choosing over some of the higher-cost systems and the implications in terms of the overall system performance.The installers were local, they were booked to come on a day forecast to be extremely hot so they came two days early and installed the system before they were due to. After our recent building experience, I can safely say they are the first Contractors I have met who were early with anything!The customer service was very good, they organised switching to a

GI Energy subcontracted the installation to Chisla Electrics. At all times I could contact GI Energy when I had queries and received immediate responses. Chisla Electrics did a great job and were very helpful in explaining the technology associated with the converter and the Fronius app.

The salesperson was really knowledgeable about the local area and asked a lot of good questions for the process.He listened and understood our needs, and gave some great sets of options.The subcontractors who completed the install were friendly and paid great attention to detail, and put in a lot of effort. Especially when having to work around the weather, and also having to redesign the panel configuration a couple times due to unforeseen issue with the roof space.  They re-designed and we still have a great configuration based on the numbers.Another follow-up more recently they improved the output to the grid after fixing a minor issue, which I wasn't even aware of, and am grateful they checked, and followed up and made the adjustments very quickly. 11/10.

Shannan Moss and his team at GI Energy provided a detailed and competitive quotation for us.We of course knew very little about solar at the time of getting quotations but needed to learn fairly quickly as the variations over the 3 companies we approached was vast.I only needed to make one phone call to Shannan and he extended me his time to explain the intricate details of the equipment differences between the 3 quotes we had received.Although GI Energy were not the cheapest we felt they were the most experienced and above all the most trusted provider.Shannan's team took charge and made everything happen seamlessly, the  information and paperwork, the process, the installation everything happened when GI Energy said it would and our occupants were at no point inconvenienced.It has been an amazing experience and we are 100% happy we did business with Shannan Moss and GI Energy.

James from GI Energy was fantastic and helped me understand the various options available. James came across as unbiased and helpful. I had one quote that I obtained early in 2023. James helped me understand that quote and advised me on the best option for our situation including what we wanted to achieve with our solar installation including batteries.Because our roof isn't straight forward, changes to the design were required to better take into consideration shade. We had some issues with the inverter software. The installer came back within a day to rectify. Our solar is now working well.
Very good to deal with during sales and negotiations through to installation
A few hiccups, installation took longer than expected. Seems to be functioning properly. Only just had the system installed, so early days yet.
Everything went well and smooth would recommend this company there before and after sales were exceptional

GI Energy provided great service, smooth process and fair price price without any 'surprises'.Having two phase power on my property made my requirements slightly non-standard.  Shannan provided sound advice and was able to answer my questions and concerns resulting a good system setup with minimal adjustments to existing.Darren completed the installation, positioning the Fronius inverter and Trina panels in my preferred location, and was able to conceal the cables well for a tidy result.  The install team arrived on time and the completed the work quickly without issue.  Darren also gave good advice on appliances / timers etc to maximise use of generated power and minimise grid consumption.Overall, happy with GI Energy.

From the very first phone call to when they guys drove away after installing my system, I can not recommend the team at GI Energy enough. They were just fantastic to deal with.They definitely weren’t the cheapest quote I got, but they were comfortably the best and most knowledgeable out of the 3 companies I spoke to, the sales person really took the time in understanding exactly what I wanted.I would recommend anyone looking in to solar to go with GI Energy!

Honestly all of the quotes I received were great, it actually made it a challenge to choose. What sold me with GI Energy was their time in the Industry, that made me feel confident that they would be around if there is a issue with my system. the GI Energy representative was honest and professional advising me about products they didn't even sell.

This is the third solar installation we have arranged for our homes over the past fifteen years. Without a doubt, the whole experience was the best so far! Beginning with Finn’s informative website and then his referrals to reputable retailers, who all bent over backwards to assist us and consider our needs.In the end, we chose the most expensive system because it seemed the best value for money and gave us a sense off “future-proofing” ourselves for the inevitable energy price rises!While everyone throughout the whole process was courteous, informative and very helpful, specific mention is due to the installation team and the information session they provided once the installation was complete. This small band of workers worked tirelessly over two days to install our system … they worked so hard in searing heat … never once complained … and treated us with the utmost courtesy! And the best bit? Our system is working a charm!

Installation was quick and efficient with safety top of mind. The fellas were tidy and solved issues of the distance covered for the cabling neatly and professionally. The placement of the inverter allows for  a future battery installation. Well done to to the entire team?

I was given the name of three solar companies by Solar Quotes.We chose GI Energy based on expertise and initial feel. Perhaps not the most scientific method! From the outset their approach was most impressive and reassuring.The initial site visit, invoicing as well as installation was excellent. The installation team was helpful and professional.All in all this has been a very good experience. I cannot recommend GI Energy too highly.

GI Energy have been great through the whole process. They were very confident with the recommendations they made for the system/brands they recommended for us. The installation booking process was easy and seamless. The installers were very friendly. Any issues I’ve had post installation were followed up and sorted out in a very timely manner. Very excited to have my solar system!

After a lot of research I decided to purchase solar.Shannan from GI Energy patiently answered all my questions and guided me with honesty. Thank you ShannanThe process from beginning to end went as planned. Top quality service and product. Highly recommended.Love the app to see how the system is performing

I did a lot of research and in the end, this system seemed to be the best value for money. I had been burnt by another installer previously, but GI were excellent to deal with. The team that installed the system were great, they couldn't have been more helpful with showing us how to set it all up.I was impressed overall by my experience with GI.

GI Energy from advice to pricing and installation we found them to be very helpful and efficient.They organised our connection to the grid and submitted all paperwork to have the system installed and working properly.

Installation was a bit on and off because of weather but the final outcome looks great: today and relatively compact given all the equipment and controls. Initial performances of the panels looks very good. Now waiting for inspection and full commissioning.

The quoting process from GI Energy was very smooth and they offered me a competitive price right from the get go. The installation itself was punctual and done on-time as scheduled.Additionally throughout the process I received great customer service from Shannan Moss who was straight to the point and patient. He helped me with understanding the differences across various solar products as well as provided me resources to look into energy retailers and get the most out of my feed-in tariff rate.
Sales/quoting process seamless and informative. Prompt responses to my many questions. Looking forward to post-installation system performance.

Very pleased with the entire process. All were very polite helpful and professional. The installing group were prompt very efficient and clean. They were very polite and willing to explain everything slowly to me. I was very comfortable having them in my house

When waying up who to choose it came down to two companies, both were supplying identical systems, however one was slightly more expensive. the more expensive option used their own installer whom I met with and whom we were leaning towards, when I remembered reading on solar quotes website that if we weren't happy with the installation that they would work with the installer to rectify any issues. This gave me peace of mind so We went with the cheaper option with not knowing who would do the install, as it turned out the install team turned up on time. worked cleanly and efficiently and we could not fault them. Tom from GI energy was very helpful in answering our questions and providing answers and guidance. All in all we are extremely pleased with our system and with solar quotes website which supplied so much information on what can be a daunting process

Initial contact listened and advised. Had one other quote but not what I was after.Arrived punctually on the date provided.Installation was difficult with an old terracotta tiled roof. I had to source 60 extra tiles as they were installing . Excellent clean up.Distribution box had been left behind so had to wait 3 weeks for installation. Some communication problems over this time. Up and running from yesterday though no consumer information as yet.

This degree of positivity will seem a little unbelievable but as someone with whose usual instinct is to want to do everything myself (including wondering if I could buy all the components on eBay and convert my whole house to run on a 48v system) because I'm so used to disappointment when I trust someone else, this whole process was a breath of fresh air.I felt that the sales pitch came with a degree of urgency but didn't feel pushed or hoodwinked and in the end a couple of things were thrown in to seal the deal. Normally I would expect the salesman to be MIA once that commission had been earned but when we left a couple of desperate after-hours messages over what we thought might be a major problem (it wasn't) we had calls from the installer and the salesman.We used solarquotes to research the virtues of the different components on offer which helped us to settle on the installer so by the time we signed up we were happy that quality and value for money had been balanced ideally. The installation was above and beyond, with extra helping hands that had not been specified in the contract as we did away with the old gas oven and hot water, even down to a neatly-performed waterproofing that was not asked for but definitely appreciated.The post-installation followup was actually better than expected as well so if this all seems a little too good to be true, it's because I've just become so used to being let down that when I feel I got more than I expected I feel I have to give full marks.As general advice I would say if you can afford it, over-spec. it. We combined this process with an EV (MG ZSev, also pleasantly surprising and already used much more than we had intended) and suddenly the gas, bottle rental, electricity bills (as best I can tell from close monitoring of the Fronius software, the first bill hasn't arrived yet) and fuel bills have evaporated. We're so close to off-grid already in winter that I feel like I only have to tolerate being on-grid as long as I feel they have some convenience to offer me. We're also no longer hostage to the whims of the scoundrels (I'm being polite) who run OPEC. It feels good.

I got three quotes and GI Energy provided what I felt was the best system available. It was not the cheapest but after researching the products and the company it looked like the best option. The whole process was super easy and the installers on the day were great to deal with. I can see from my online monitoring that the solar is producing more energy than they promised in their quotation. I also had lots of questions after the install and they took a lot of time to go through everything with me. I am very happy and I have already recommended them to a few friends.A very professional company who have been really easy to deal with pre and post install. If I had to do it all again, I would definitely use GI Energy

Initial contact was friendly and refreshing after previously trying to deal with companies from Facebook ads. Salesmen listened to what i wanted and provided appropriate products and options for what i wanted (reasonably priced solar/battery system). They did overstate the northern roof panel capacity (even when asked to double check due to other installers saying it was too much, and that was corrected once the installers did the site inspection. This was corrected and new figures provided which bought it very close to being a viable solution and at this point it did feel a bit more "salesy" when they suggested their figures were very conservative and electricity prices would probably increase more than the 4% quoted and the performance of the system would probably perform better than stated.The install team were very polite, friendly and turned up on time on the days told. I was put at ease by them encouraging me to ask any questions i had, which i did, and they were happy to answer. I also appreciated the consideration of our neighbors considering we live in a strata complex.During installation i noticed that while they gave us a late upgrade to black panels, they still used the silver mounting brackets, which in my opinion looks silly/out of place. It turned what would have been a good looking system install, into something that doesn't quite look right. Not sure why they wouldn't have changed the brackets to match. When i contacted the Gi energy, twice about it, they didn't respond on either occasion to that concern i had.As for the rest of the install, the inverter and battery was installed neatly in the location we wanted. However, it wasn't successfully connected for monitoring by ethernet as we had discussed both during the sales/consultation process as well as stipulated in the site visit. I had run the cable to the location, and it appeared to be connected, but didn't work, only by wifi. when i contacted Gi, they had their IT guy contact me a couple of days later who didn't know how to fix it. He was going to organise a conference call with sungrow to problem solve it, but he cancelled it because sungrow couldn't make that time. I haven't heard from him since (about two weeks ago). The installers did give me a call to try and help, but they didn't know why and told be to google it or youtube it. I then started getting emails from gi asking for finial payment, however i was initially told during the sales process final payment is due 3 days after install to ensure it was all working correctly. As the system still wasn't working as it should have been, and poor response from Gi, i was withholding the payment until it was resolved. ( the communication/response was poor before the payment, i can only imagine what it would be like after i paid).I ended up spending many hours googling, Youtubing   trying to resolve the problem myself Which i was a bit nervous about due to having no electrical/Solar knowledge and was concerned i might break something or put in a wrong setting. I also joined the sungrow installers facebbok page trying to find the problem. Sungrow has a lot of information on the internet, but its not dated or organised, so i found it hard to navigate through to find relevant information.Eventually, i contacted sungrow directly, which sounds obvious, but everything i had heard and read indicated that they wont deal directly with end users only installers, and even then it would be hit and miss on how helpful they were. To my surprise, they answered the phone, acknowledged i was an end user and after i explained what was going on helped me to resolve the issue after a bit of digging around. (turns out it wasn't configured properly, and needed to be unplugged and re plugged in).Disappointing i had to spend a few nights and afternoons trying to resolve it myself.I still havent heard back from it to confirm its working or not, or in regards to the mismatched brackets being corrected.My recommendation to my friends and family is now to take a gamble on the cheaper guys (which would have saved me about $4000, or the equivalent on 2 years electricity bills on this $18,000 system) as my other neighbors  have all had good experiences with the cheaper guys.

I did shop around for quotes and I found GI Energy the most honest and friendly people to deal with. They gave me a clear understanding of what I will be getting from my solar panels and what will fit in with my budget. The sales and quote process went smoothly as did the installation. The guys were punctual and very polite. I would highly recommend GI Energy to my friends and family.

GI Energy were great in working with us and spent a considerable amount of time on site discussing the logistics of our roof design and shading issues.
